content.thinking: `/usr/bin/time` isn't available. Let me use bash's `time` and measure memory differently (e.g., via resource module in a wrapper).

arguments.command: cd /app/tmp && for f in big_stream big_burst big_idle; do echo "== $f"; ( time python3 -I -B /app/submission/scheduler.py < $f.json > $f.out ) 2>&1 | grep real; echo "rc=$?"; wc -c $f.out; done
